---
description: Implement one validated autonomous task contract
---
Use the project-orchestrator agent. Validate the task YAML against `schemas/task.schema.json`; resolve its story, ADRs, dependencies and allowed paths; choose the primary specialist and required reviewers; implement the smallest vertical change; run required checks; produce the handoff from `TASK-CONTRACT.md`; create a PR eligible for protected automerge. Stop after two failed repair attempts and report a blocked task with evidence.
